bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 创纪录后降温

read.en: AMD hit a record $658.52 on Oct 6 and has slipped 8% since. The trend is still strongly up: the 30-day ($560) and 100-day ($520) averages are rising fast and price is well above both. The short-term signals have turned, though. Price fell below the 5 and 10-day averages, MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 9, Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Oct 8, and RSI dropped from 72 to 57.
read.zh: AMD 于 10月6日创下 $658.52 纪录，此后回落 8%。趋势仍强劲向上：30 日（$560）与 100 日（$520）均线快速上行，股价远高于两者。但短线信号已转弱：股价跌破 5 日和 10 日均线，MACD 于 10月9日下穿信号线，抛物线 SAR 于 10月8日转空，RSI 由 72 降至 57。

read.en: The first support is $590, a late-September pivot. Below that, the 30-day average and July highs around $560 are a strong area where a pullback in an uptrend often ends. To get going again AMD needs to reclaim $623–631 (the short averages), then $639 and the $658 record.
read.zh: 首个支撑为 9月下旬的转折点 $590。其下，30 日均线与 7月高点（约 $560）是强支撑区，上升趋势中的回调常在此结束。AMD 需重新站上 $623–631（短期均线），再突破 $639 及 $658 纪录高点，才能重拾升势。
